testCases.label: Returns true when arrays are identical
testCases.description: Verifies that equal(...) returns true when both input arrays contain the same elements in the same order.

testCases.label: Detects unequal arrays with different repeated values
testCases.description: Checks that equal(...) returns false when one array contains repeated 4s and the other is [0,1,2,3,4].

testCases.label: Detects unequal arrays with a single differing element
testCases.description: Ensures that equal(...) returns false when arrays differ by only the last element.
